name: socat
description: Multipurpose relay and network socket tool - universal data connector

socat.description: Netcat on steroids - establishes two bidirectional byte streams and transfers data between them with support for files, pipes, devices, sockets, SSL, proxy connections
socat.usage: socat TCP4-LISTEN:80,fork TCP4:192.168.1.10:80\nsocat - TCP4:www.example.com:80\nsocat TCP4-LISTEN:8080,reuseaddr,fork EXEC:cmd.exe,pipes
